question:
If I denotes ‘÷’, J denotes ‘×’, K denotes ‘−’ and L denotes ‘+’, then what will come in place of ‘?’ in the following equation?

19 L (22 J 4) K (66 I 11) L (16 J 2) = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png]

Given:

19 L (22 J 4) K (66 I 11) L (16 J 2) 

After replacing the signs from left to right and using the BODMAS rule,

= 19 +** (22 × 4)** - **(66 ÷ 11) **+ **(16 × 2)**

= 19 + 88 - 6 + 32

= **133**

Hence, “133” is the correct answer.
